title: Align npm workspace dependency versions
why: Private workspace packages using incompatible major requirements for the same registry dependency can install duplicate implementations and make repository-wide upgrades inconsistent.
suggestion: Choose one reviewed compatible major requirement for private workspace packages unless the divergence is intentional.
limitations: Only literal workspace members and dependencies in member package.json files marked private are compared; TypeScript compiler requirements are also read from devDependencies.
Only direct exact, caret, or tilde registry requirements with different nonzero majors are reported.
Published packages, other development and peer dependencies, wildcard members, aliases, protocols, URLs, Git sources, and complex ranges are excluded.
